title: FairCoT: Enhancing Fairness in Text-to-Image Generation via Chain of Thought Reasoning with Multimodal Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper includes a dedicated component for evaluating and mitigating religious bias in text-to-image models. It specifically defines religious groups (Islam, Christianity, Hinduism, Judaism, Sikhism) and their associated attire or symbols (e.g., hijab, cross, bindi, turban) as key attributes for systematic fairness benchmarking and prediction.
